host.description: Host address to bind the Hoogle server to.

port.description: Port number to listen on for HTTP requests.

key.description: API key for securing the server endpoints.

database.description: Path to the Hoogle database file (.hoo) to serve.

https.description: Whether to enable HTTPS/TLS for the server.

ca.description: Path to the CA certificate file for HTTPS.

cert.description: Path to the server certificate file for HTTPS.

keypath.description: Path to the server private key file for HTTPS.

compress.description: Whether to enable Gzip compression for responses.

threads.description: Number of worker threads to use for handling requests.

base.description: The base URL path for the Hoogle server.

packages.description: List of package database files to include in the search index.
